programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangsters secrets.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lovers outrage.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Gurus father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her familys death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijays father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Haathon Ki Lakeeren
programme.desc: A dramatic story of the anguish and despair felt by a woman who is about to be separated from a child she adopted when the biological parents turn up on her doorstep demanding their child back.

programme.title: Samay-when the time strikes
programme.desc: ACP Malvika Chauhan, a widowed mother, is assigned to investigate the murder of a businessman. However, she suspects it to be a serial killer as more murders take place in the city.

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Ek Se Bure Do
programme.desc: Jagat, a gangster, hires Toti and Tony to steal a treasure map. But they provide him with a fake copy of the map and reserve the original. When Jagat learns about it, he plans to teach them a lesson.

programme.title: Goonj
programme.desc: Wedged in a political chaos, Sanjeev has to prove his innocence for a murder he did not commit and expose the real rogue, MLA Kalekar. But, the culprit is also the father of the girl he loves.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With Chandlers Work Laugh: When Ross discovers that Emily is getting remarried, he hits a new low by sleeping with one of Chandlers old flames...Janice! (S5, E12)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With Mrs. Bing: Chandlers romance-novelist mother comes to New York to visit, but her promiscuity, combined with an emotional Ross, results in a regretful moment of passion. (S1, E11)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With The Evil Orthodontist: Rachel and Barry start dating again, even though he is engaged to Mindy. Mindy then asks Rachel to be her maid of honour which adds to her guilt. (S1, E20)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One where Rachel Finds Out: During Rachels birthday party, Chandler accidentally lets it slip that Ross is in love with her. (S1, E24)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One After the Superbowl (2): Rachel and Monica compete for the affections of Jean-Claude Van Damme after meeting him on a movie set. Julia Roberts also guest-stars. (S2, E13)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With The Princess Leia Fantasy: Ross reveals a fantasy to Rachel involving a certain "Star Wars" character. Meanwhile, Monica suffers from insomnia after her breakup with Richard. (S3, E01)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With A Chick And A Duck: When Pete buys a restaurant, Monica must decide whether to accept his offer of employment there. Meanwhile, Joey and Chandler adopt a duck and a chick. (S3, E21)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With Rosss Thing: Ross finds a strange growth on his buttocks and Phoebe cant choose between two guys. Meanwhile, Monicas boyfriend surprises her by not proposing...(S3, E23)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With The Ultimate Fighting Champion: Phoebe sets Ross up on a date with a woman who used to be bald. Robin Williams and Billy Crystal guest star. (S3, E24)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With Joeys New Girlfriend: Joey thinks that Chandler hates Joeys new girlfriend, Kathy. However, little does he know, its exactly the opposite. (S4, E05)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One With Rachels New Dress: Phoebe gets to name one of her babies which leads to Joey telling Chandler that he has a terrible name. Rachels plan to seduce her boyfriend goes awry. (S4, E18)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love
programme.desc: The One Where Everybody Finds Out: Ross rents an apartment with a window facing Monica and Rachels place. While checking out the apartment, Phoebe sees Monica and Chandler having sex. (S5, E14)

programme.desc: The One Where Phoebe Runs: Rachel is embarrassed by Phoebes "flamboyant" running style and tries to avoid her on her morning jogs. Elle Macpherson guest stars. (S6, E07)

programme.title: Friends: Lust and Love

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick visits a food festival in the Yorkshire Dales, where he gets inspiration to make a curd cheese tart. Plus, he checks out a wonderful organic veg garden. S2, Ep2

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick shares his recipe for fresh crayfish with chopped tomatoes, basil and spaghetti. Plus, he gets a food tour of Ludlow from talented chef Shaun Hill. S2, Ep3

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick learns about a world-famous sticky toffee pudding thats made in the Lake District. Plus, he joins two fishermen as they catch sea trout on the River Towy. S2, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick admires the quality produce on offer at the English Market in Cork, Ireland. He is inspired to cook corned beef with potatoes, carrots and cabbage. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: After visiting an award-winning herb grower, Rick uses fresh ingredients to make a delicious pork terrine. And, he samples oatcakes in Stoke-on-Trent. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick gathers butchers from Smithfield Market to see whether they can taste the difference between organic and non-organic beef. Plus, he cooks beef stroganoff. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick and Chalky go fishing for large langoustines on Loch Torridon. And, he travels to the Cotswolds to explore a farm that grows enormous cooking apples. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick goes reef fishing for sea bass in the Channel Island of Jersey, before enjoying a beach barbecue. Later, he goes pheasant shooting in Cornwall. S2, Ep9

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick Stein is in Cornwall to meet a fish merchant who has helped make pilchards popular again. Plus, he visits a successful food festival in Wales. S2, Ep10

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Rick travels to Ayrshire to meet the butchers behind a world-famous bacon. Plus, he reveals his recipe for lamb koftas with yoghurt and salad. S2, Ep11

programme.title: Rick Steins Food Heroes
programme.desc: Lord Coke invites Rick and Chalky to go partridge shooting in Norfolk. Plus, Rick rediscovers traditional favourites like Kentish cobnuts and quinces. S2, Ep12

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: The Patient Cook. Chef Asma Khan celebrates being a patient cook with slow cooked kosha mangsho, a divine duck bhuna, veg filled parathas and an incredible dessert. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: The Classics. Chef Asma Khan enjoys timeless Indian classics, from a delicious dal and jhal farezi to tangy aloo gobi matter and historic 1st Class Railway Curry. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Tangra: Kolkatas China Town. Chef Asma Khans recipes are inspired by Kolkatas Chinatown. They include chicken, chilli steak with spicy mash and mouthwatering Tangra prawns. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Sweet Things. Chef Asma Khan showcases the beauty of Indian desserts, with fragrant kheer, a spiced bread and butter pudding, a chocolate treat and banana fritters. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Of Rice And Bread. Rice and bread dishes are popular, especially the aloo paratha. Asma Kahn cooks prawn biryani, friendship rotis made to share and a syrupy sweet. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Finding Flavour. Chef Asma Khan celebrates herbs and marinades. Fenugreek methi chicken, the hariyali baked version, and mouth-watering tamarind prawns. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Sumptuous Snacks. Chef Asma Khan makes spiced Kabab Burgers, crispy monsoon pakoras, flavourful koftas and indulgent chilli cheese toasties - perfect sumptuous snacks. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Star Vegetables. Chef Asma Khan celebrates vegetables with Shimla mirch paneer, 9 jewel korma, pumpkin niramish and a delicious watermelon curry - a feast of spices. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Street Food. Chef Asma Khan celebrates the joy of street food, featuring chicken momos, potato and sweetcorn patties, lamb jali kabab and paneer skewers. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Secrets Of The Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Best Of Bengal. Asma loves cooking Bengali influenced food. On the menu is her mothers prawn malaikari, an omelette curry, a rich fish curry, and a coconut dessert. S1, Ep10

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Lancashire. James continues his adventure in Lancashire with chef Lisa Allen. They visit Lisas hometown, Clitheroe, where they prepare a lovely John Dory dish. S1, Ep6

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Snowdonia. James heads to North Wales with Stephen Terry. They have a five-star meal at Pale Hall, then James cooks Welsh lamb with gnocchi. S1, Ep7

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Pembrokeshire. James and Stephen are heading south through Wales en route to Pembrokeshire. They visit Michelin-starred restaurant Ynyshir, run by chef Gareth Ward. S1, Ep8

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Northern Irish Coast. James explores Northern Ireland with famous local chef Paul Rankin. James cooks up a delicious dish that celebrates the amazing seafood on offer. S1, Ep9

programme.title: James Martins Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Belfast. James Martin and Paul Rankin head to Pauls hometown, Belfast. There, he gives James a personal tour of Northern Irelands capital city. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Sicilian And Seafood. Guy goes to Oklahoma City to test out the offerings from a wood-fired pizza truck. Plus, in Fort Lauderdale he enjoys Brazilian and Caribbean seafood dishes. S31, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Fillin Up In Florence. Guy explores traditional Italian spots in Florence. First, he goes to a 50-year-old landmark with legendary spaghetti, before going to a popular pizza place. S22, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: International Appeal. Guy goes on an international culinary tour. In Stockton, he has an Asian rice noodle soup before heading to San Francisco for Puerto Rican and Cuban favourites. S24, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Bird And Beef. Guy is after awesome avian food and beef this trip, like the Dallas spot smoking both duck and brisket. In Phoenix, a Mexican place dishes out barbacoa and gorditas. S28, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives

programme.desc: NHK World-Japans flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Impacts: Climates Change the World
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan presents a variety of short programmes focusing on Japan and Asia.

programme.title: An Evolving Font
programme.desc: Contemporary artist Miyanaga Aiko visits Kyoto - the Mincho font, which was drawn by hand in around 1990, evokes 350-year-old hand-carved woodblocks made to print Buddhist sutras.

programme.title: Where We Call Home
programme.desc: We meet Austrian fashion designer Edwina Horl Ota, who works to bring her late husbands Tokyo ramen shop back to its former glory, and Chinese Masuda Sei who cleans up bullet trains at Tokyo Station.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japans flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Time-Lapse Japan
programme.desc: The Jomon period dates roughly from 13,000 to 300 B.C. - we examine various aspects of Jomon society with footage from time-lapse creator Shimizu Daisuke. This time: the Sannai Maruyama Site.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Japans snow is a big draw for tourists, but snow and ice can also pose dangers to drivers - we look at some Japanese technology being developed to prevent whiteouts and accidents.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history, and culture - this episode looks at words related to hot water. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.desc: #7 Please speak slowly. / To ask someone to speak slowly, say yukkuri hanashite kudasai.

programme.desc: Japanese high-tech toys, fusing advanced technology and kawaii culture, are booming, even in education and space exploration. Through a Chinese woman at a toy maker, we look at their global advance.

programme.desc: We introduce a line-up of programmes conveying Japans unique perspectives and cultural practices - themes include falconry, etiquette, and the National Museum of Japanese History.

programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nations long history.

programme.title: Monkey Life

programme.title: David Attenboroughs...

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Courtship: Dating is just as tricky a business in the insect world, and Sir David Attenborough finds out how certain bugs choose and then woo their partners. (Ep 3 of 6)

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters

programme.title: David Attenborough: Micro Monsters
programme.desc: Family: Join Sir David Attenborough as he zooms in on a set of bugs who prefer cooperation to conflict, from the burrowing cockroach to a queen bee. (Ep 5 of 6)

programme.title: Moon: Natures Secret Force
programme.desc: Dining by Moonlight: Predator and prey live and die by lunar rules, as moonlight reveals or conceals lifes nightly battle for survival. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Moon: Natures Secret Force
programme.desc: Moonlit Romance: From frozen Arctic tundra to tropical seas, the Moons rhythms ignite natures most intimate, dazzling and life-giving love stories. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Moon: Natures Secret Force
programme.desc: Guided by the Moon: Across land, sea and sky, animals follow the Moons hidden forces to navigate epic journeys across the planet. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Airborne

programme.title: Airborne
programme.desc: In-Flight Meals: Each species evolves unique tools to outpace rivals in the eat-or-be-eaten game, taking to the skies is the ultimate advantage. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Airborne

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough

programme.title: Secret World of Sound with David Attenborough
programme.desc: Finding a Voice: Follow baby animals as they learn to communicate to survive, using sound to call for help in their early days. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Jawani Zindabad
programme.desc: Determined to eradicate the social evil of dowry from society, Shashi marries her sister to Ravi without offering dowry. However, his insistence leads to a series of unfortunate attacks from society.

programme.title: Dacait
programme.desc: A young man is severely beaten up and left to die while his family is killed by Thakurs men. However, some dacoits rescue him and take him to their hideout.

programme.title: Conversation With Rajkummar Rao 1
programme.desc: Rajkummar Rao, one of the most talented and versatile actors today, talks about his being an outsider to the industry, the different shades of unique characters he plays and his success. (1/2)

programme.title: Awaargi
programme.desc: Azad rescues a girl from a brothel, attracting the ire of the mob, and helps her achieve her dream with Dhirens aid. However, both the men fall in love with her while the mobs seek revenge on Azad.

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: When Asha becomes pregnant, after having affairs with three men simultaneously, she moves to Mauritius to raise her daughter, content that no one knows about her past.

programme.title: Bundal Baaz
programme.desc: Trash collector Raja finds a magic lamp with a genie that insists on helping him. After a few disastrous adventures, Raja tries to get rid of the pesky genie.

programme.title: Kabhi Na Kabhi
programme.desc: Jaggu gets arrested after a witness informs the police about his crimes. Meanwhile, Raja is hired in his place. Once out, Jaggu kills the witness, who happens to be Rajas father.

programme.title: Ajanabee
programme.desc: Middle-classed Rohit (Rajesh Khanna) falls in love with rich Reshmi (Zeenat Aman) and marries her. But fate has other plans and he gets arrested for the murder which he never committed.

programme.title: Namak Haram
programme.desc: Two young men from vastly different worlds, a Delhi slum and a Calcutta mansion, form a bond that is put to the ultimate test.

programme.title: Mazzaq
programme.desc: Pretending as mentally challenged and unemployed, Vinod earns his bread in Bombay. Soon he finds a job in Bangalore and falls for the CEOs daughter. Crisis strikes when her dad learns about his past.

programme.title: Meri Bhabhi
programme.desc: Rajoo and Maya decide to give their child to Rajoos sister-in-law, Shanti, when she gives birth to a stillborn baby. However, unaware of this fact, she humiliates them on several occasions.

programme.title: Darna Zaroori Hai
programme.desc: Six children get lost in a forest in the middle of the night. They reach a haunted house where an old woman challenges them to sit through a narration of six horrific stories.

programme.title: Love Love Love
programme.desc: The son of a taxi driver falls in love with a the daughter of a wealthy mobster whom wants her to marry his business partners son.

programme.title: Jaaneman
programme.desc: Suhaan, an aspiring actor, is in a fix when Piya files for divorce and forces him to pay a large amount as alimony. To avoid paying her, Suhaan uses Agastyas love for Piya and helps him woo her.

programme.title: Patthar Ke Sanam
programme.desc: Rajesh works for Meenas father. Meena and her friend Taruna decide to play a prank on him. Both women pretend to fall in love with him, but he finds out, resulting in acrimony.

programme.title: Professor Ki Padosan
programme.desc: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobhas ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

programme.title: Haath Ki Safai
programme.desc: Raj, orphaned and separated from his brother, finds himself hungry and desolate in Mumbai. He is taken in by a pickpocket and grows up to be an adept thief. He befriends Kamini, a wealthy runaway.

programme.title: Dil E Nadaan
programme.desc: Unaware of each others feelings, thick pals Vikram and Anand fall for the same woman. However, an unexpected incident changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Damaad
programme.desc: Sharad is head over the heels in love with Renu, his neighbours daughter. However, problems arise when two of his employers want him to get married to either of their daughters.

programme.title: Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman
programme.desc: Raju comes to Bombay chasing his dreams, but keeps losing out on opportunities. His love, Renu helps him find a job. Success goes to his head until one day a tragic accident destroys his reputation.

programme.title: Animal
programme.desc: The son of a wealthy, powerful industrialist returns to India and undergoes a remarkable transformation as he becomes consumed by a quest for vengeance against those threatening his fathers life.

programme.title: Sukhee
programme.desc: Fed up with her mundane existence, a housewife gets to relive the past while attending a school reunion.

programme.title: Check
programme.desc: The story of a prisoner on Death row fighting his wrongful conviction in the backdrop of Chess.

programme.title: Main Atal Hoon
programme.desc: Statesman and poet, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayees eloquence and vision shaped Indias destiny. A biopic on his remarkable life and legacy.
